items.title: Evaluator Decision Tree
items.done_when: A visitor can pick the right DotMatch entry path in under one minute without broad claims.

items.title: Persona One-Pagers
items.primary_audience: core facilities, CRISPR teams, workflow maintainers, assay developers
items.done_when: Each priority audience has a one-page pitch, proof path, and first command.

items.title: Integration Target Tracker
items.done_when: Every target integration has an owner, upstream URL, readiness state, and next action.

items.title: Reviewer Evidence Packet
items.done_when: A reviewer can find install, outputs, claim boundaries, evidence, and citation text from one checklist.

items.title: Conference Abstracts
items.done_when: Short and long abstracts are ready for workflow, core facility, and methods venues.

items.title: Social And Forum Pack
items.done_when: Release posts, technical threads, and forum prompts are ready without unsupported claims.

items.title: Maintainer Issue Templates
items.done_when: External issue or PR openings can be copied with scope, outputs, tests, and review asks.

items.title: Pilot Scorecard
items.done_when: Pilot feedback can be scored without turning private evaluation into an external-use record.

items.title: Adoption KPI Dashboard Spec
items.done_when: The project tracks exposure health separately from scientific claims and release quality.

items.title: Release Communications Calendar
items.done_when: Each release has a pre-merge, tag, channel-verification, and follow-up communication plan.
